serverInfo.name: CalEvents
serverInfo.description: Public UC Berkeley campus event discovery for agents. Tools run in the browser through WebMCP. Everything else is a static file.

transports.description: Browser only. The homepage registers its tools on navigator.modelContext. There is no remote MCP endpoint to connect to.
RFC 9264 linkset of the static JSON and text resources. It is a catalog, not an MCP endpoint.

tools.browser: WebMCP tools register on the homepage from the app bundle when navigator.modelContext is available. They run only in that browser tab: search_berkeley_events (ranked search; reports interpretations, effectiveDateRange, relaxed, fallbackMessage, and total for paging with offset), list_filter_options (valid categories, active sources, date presets, topics), get_event_by_id, generate_event_ics, get_cal_events_feed_status, get_ui_state (URL state plus a view snapshot of what the page shows; read again while view.pending is true), apply_ui_state (replace or merge; chip dismissal is search-only, through search_berkeley_events dismiss), build_calevents_url, get_event_directions. An unknown or retired value, or a date that is not YYYY-MM-DD, is an error.

whats-on-tonight.description: Find UC Berkeley events happening tonight (Pacific).

messages.content: Search CalEvents for events tonight. Call search_berkeley_events with datePreset today, plus a query or a topic slug from list_filter_options. If relaxed is set, tell the user which filter was dropped, using fallbackMessage. Summarize the top matches with time, location, and official url. Optionally call apply_ui_state with date today and the same q so the open page matches.

is-feed-healthy.description: Check whether the CalEvents ingestion feed is healthy and fresh.

messages.content: Call get_cal_events_feed_status. Report generated_at and total_events. Mention degraded or fallback sources to the user only when data_quality_blocked is true. Otherwise treat the feed as usable and avoid user-facing source warnings. Report topics.outcome and topics.carried_forward_count separately from source health, plus topics.error when present. A topic assignment error does not make an event source degraded.

ics-for-event.description: Produce an .ics calendar payload for a known CalEvents event id.

messages.content: Given an event id, call generate_event_ics. Return the filename and ics text, and mention googleCalendarUrl when present. Without an id, find one with search_berkeley_events first.

share-this-event.description: Build a shareable CalEvents deep link for an event or search.

messages.content: Use build_calevents_url with event and/or q/date/category/topic/source. Take valid values from list_filter_options. To share what the open page shows, read get_ui_state and pass its filters and selectedEventId. Prefer the permalink for sharing; use the official event url for tickets.
